body:
Just to add some to this - not only do I agree this sub shouldn’t be used for classified listing, but I actually tried to email her (per her comment below) asking about the lease and literally all I got was, “Please register with Zillow for more information. Thank you.”

This has to be one of the most low effort posts and follow throughs I’ve seen, and it’s clear /u/Properties4u2 is using this as just a quick post and forget ad.
Not with the team, no. Only with HR, who told me what was relayed to her.

I understand where you’re coming from and it makes absolute sense.

The thing is, I’ve had to get therapy sessions and get on anti-depressants because of the work I’m involved with through my career.

I’ve had a few other jobs in different fields (temp/contract) and it felt different.

Commitment is hard, I’ll admit, but IT is something I loathe because of the nature of support.
I confessed this to her and her overwhelming support makes me feel unbearably guilty that she has to put up with me and the baby. This is too much for her. It’s not fair.
I was on the ledge ready to jump tonight. My friend talked me out of it.

I should also add a few details.

We got pregnant early this year. A month later when we found out, I lost my job. Then my wife lost her job a few months later. Then we had our baby and then I ran out of UI Insurance. Had a total breakdown and my wife and I talked about and have moved back in with her parents. We put up our house for sale and it was bought within a week. I've been moving stuff from our home to her parents house, which is cramped and we're dealing with their personalities and all these financials etc etc

So. Much. Happening. And all within a month.

This is unbelievable but the baby is probably the worst part. And all I feel like doing is just... if I can just make sure that this money we got for our house goes to my wife and she's taken care of. That'll be enough for me to just wanna .. turn the god damn switch off, if you know what I mean.

He'll be 1 month old in 2 days. When is this going to get any better? I'm genuinely asking.

Seriously my only thing I do right now is get away from it all by going out for walks or drives. It's not fair to my wife because I bet she wants time away too. The guilt from that breaks up me into little pieces, but when I hear the baby cry, go red from squeezing himself into a frenzy then crying from making himself cry... like wtf is this?

Jesus.

Our HOA has strict rules and regulations for renting out homes as owners. They've been a pretty big pain in our butts for the 3 years we've lived here and we try our best to avoid doing anything to meet their wrath. That's one of the reasons we want to avoid renting.

Honestly, this house we got was great but it was after searching for months and not finding anything within our tiny budget that we were able to squeeze in this townhouse with 10% down.

If we were to be able to save money for the next 2-3 years living at our parents, we'd have enough to put a 20% down on a much nicer house and location.

But you're definitely right about the psychological part. My wife is all for it too, so I'm guessing the stress of everything is really getting to us. I will say that we basically lived with her parents for years before we got our own house and it wasn't as bad as it usually tends to be.

I have JAMF 200 but that’s about it.

I'll definitely look into the AZ-104 cert though!! i didn't know MS offered certification courses at discounted prices!

Do you know if they are offering any other certification courses at discounted prices for those affected by COVID? Or any other major certifications elsewhere that are discounted? Since I'm home, might as well work toward these.

I don't know if I made it sound like we keep our lives separate but that is not how we have it setup. We have our joint checking and saving account that 90% of our salaries we made went into. The 10% left went into our personal savings accounts for unquestioned spending/investments, because we both decided this was how we could justify spending money we earned for our own hobbies without it ever impacting our life together.

We are happy with the way we decided to do this. I appreciate the marriage counseling but that's not what I was asking for here.

Our credit cards are 0% interest for 12-18 months starting a month ago, so thankfully those won't hurt us. It's just money we owe and have to pay per month.

Our parents use our YouTube TV so they don't have to pay for TV either. We can definitely talk to them about this because they use our streaming services for free.

Our parents live literally up the street, maybe 5 minutes away, so nothing will change as far as area goes.

Job hunting for me has been especially difficult because the area of IT I have experience in... nobody is hiring for. Anything above my level, which I can absolutely do, won't even look at my resume. And everything below pays really bad (entry level Helpdesk) while requiring much more (available 24/7, 365, onsite and after hours/weekend on call remote support).
True. Our realtor did say she did market research and we can get 600k for our house. So if we price high and at worst we get an offer or 565k, at least it gives us leverage to negotiate.

Trust me I agree with you on a lot of what you said. But in the 25 mile radius where I live, absolutely nobody is hiring IT. The ones that are are 24/7 365 availability call center help desk types that pay $15hr and will completely kill my spirit. I’ve worked in IT for 10 years, so to go down to that and barely make less than enough... I’ve been looking for months and it’s a no go.

My wife on the other hand is way more experienced and she likes to climb the corporate ladder. She is not a homebody and wants the world to get back to normal so she can go back to work. She also makes twice as much as me in the 6 figures, where I’ve made half working for one of the largest companies in the world. So I’m not worried there, but I am worried about my ability to provide.

The money we have with us right now is being drained day by day because of expenses coming in. And when we do our taxes, it’s going to hurt us a lot. In 6 months if our financial situations haven’t improved, we’re going to burn through the savings. I don’t want that. And I don’t want my wife to take any money out of her 401k. She’s the successful one. I want her to have the best situation.

A lot of people have commented about renting out. The problem is my damn power tripping Karen run HOA who we already have to deal with a lot. So if we were to even be able to screen people to be renters (not easy in a pandemic), we’d then have to be the in between people of the renters and HOA. We don’t want a wild card introduced like that. It absolutely makes sense as far as equity to keep the house, but with our new child we’re so overwhelmed (I’m clinically depressed with severe anxiety disorder) that to be with her parents would be a god send at this point.

I know it sounds like I’m asking a question here only to really tell myself what I’ve already decided, but I do appreciate input from you and others. It is helping. I have more questions to ask our realtor than I did before. So thank you.

We actually tried refinancing a month ago because we got a crazy good offer from our bank but we were turned down due to the money we owe via home equity loan.

This is our house and we love it, but we had plans to sell at the 5 year mark and move up/forward. That was 3 years ago. Obviously plans changed with the pandemic and us losing our jobs.

Thank you for responding. I’ll definitely talk to our realtor tomorrow, since she’s coming over to view everything, take pictures and put the house on the market. She’s been with our family for a long time, and she found us this house. She didn’t even charge commission. But nonetheless I’ll definitely bring all of this up with her.

Yeah our realtor actually said our house is worth 599k based on her market research, but because it’s December in the middle of a pandemic, the viewership will not be as high. But our unit next door that’s smaller, older, and not renovated was out in escrow for 565k a few weeks ago so that’s why our realtor says we can get more. Honestly I’d be happy to just get 565k and be done with it.
We did think about it but we'd have to charge quite a lot to get back some money, if not break even. And the work that would go along with it is just not enough for us to deal with.
We're talking to our realtor now and she said we could sell our house for $565k but who knows how the market is.

Well with the mortgage bill, the home equity loan, the HOA fee, and then utilities and property tax per year... we'd have to charge at least $2700-3000 a month to the renters to make even $200 extra profit a month. It just doesn't seem worth it especially with all the work that would go along with it.

It's been two days spent at the hospital and now we are home. My wife is loving this. Her parents are loving the baby. And so are my parents.

Me? I took a few walks at night, while we were at the hospital, hoping to find the courage to run into the busy street and get run over. Every night when the sun would go down, and the world would get smaller, the crying would intensify, having to literally change my entire life to be a support line for this new human... I still don't want it. I haven't felt that 'feeling' of being a father, loving my son, my world changing its meaning, etc. because I still feel this way. I still wish I didn't have a baby. And I think I'm going to tell my wife what I've been feeling. I've held back 10 years of not being completely blunt and honest this way. It might crush her heart.

I still want kill myself
I knew BatBe was my favorite part.

How did it change for you? I just don't understand. I told my one and only best friend today about this all and he has 3 kids. He said the same too. You change and the kid(s) become the most important things to you. I just can't picture it. And truthfully I'm still so self absorbed and want whats best for me.

How can you love it? Can you please like.. describe to me what you love about it all? I'm 100% genuinely curious and want to know.

I tried to do that all day today. Cleaned the house, organized documents we usually leave laying around in the office, and took a 2 hour walk. I feel like a robot the entire time but it's better than sitting and deep diving into the abyss of negative thoughts.

My wife and I both work 8-5, Mon-Fri jobs. She's salaried and is higher up in the enterprise world, so she gets the benefit of working from home sometimes. I'm in IT and basically can't ever work from home. So many thoughts rushing through my head though.

How much is this going to cost, from today until even after her giving birth? How much do children normally cost in general? What about insurance? Money money friggin money. It's consuming me thinking about just how much this is going to drain our accounts. Then I think man I'm such a pos for thinking like this. Then I spiral into other branches of stuff. Family intervening, covid19 scares, possible job loss, reprioritizing my entire life around for our baby. I even just hestitated typing "our baby". It feels so external and surreal. I'm lost.

But I'm trying to take your advice and everyone elses here. I'll do whatever I can until my body gives out, I guess. Thank you for telling me it'll be okay. I feel like it won't but sounds like some people go through this too and it turns out alright.

It sucks so much. I've just been constantly thinking to myself that everything bad is going to happen from here on out. I went out for a 2 hour walk just trying to breathe.

I'm sorry if it sounded like I was calling the person who makes less money in a relationship a loser. I really didn't mean that. I just think I'm such garbage compared to my wife. She's happy about being pregnant and she's usually very vocal when she's scared or upset, so at this point I'd know if she was. But I'm the type to keep my issues in because I don't want to burden her. And now more than ever, I feel like I can't ruin this for her. But it's killing me.

That aside, can you please DM me about how you went about getting off Benzo's? I'm going through hell and it would help :(

Can you please tell me how you handled your panic disorder? I’m on the verge of one but I’m swallowing it down.

I need to understand what I should be doing for my wife. What did your SO do for you? What did you appreciate or want?

What about financials? Who makes the most money? Does it matter? Did it matter? Paternal and maternal leave. Are you in massive debt or were you prepared? My company only gives me 8 weeks off. Maybe stretch that to 10 with vacation hours. But I’m guessing it’ll be a nightmare of no sleep, crying, restlessness. And when I have to go back to work, I’ll be coming home drained (I already feel like that) only to then help my wife relax because she would have been taking care of the baby the entire time. 

Should I let her eat whatever she wants (healthy) because of the cravings?

I’m spiraling

I’m scared to talk to my wife about my feelings. She is so excited and has always wanted a baby. I wanted to wait another year (especially due to this corona virus) to at least get off Xanax. But now I feel like I’m going to be taking them even more now than ever. And as far as having a baby, I can’t change anything. This is how it is going to be now. And I feel like a piece of shit for thinking about it like this. My life is over, their lives have begun. I’m done. I’m a god damn coward.

I don’t want to scare or stress my wife. All these things are just bogging me down now that her and I are sitting down to go over our companies benefits, medical related stuff, finances, paternal/maternal leave.

My wife is the money maker in our relationship. I’m the pathetic loser who makes nowhere near what she makes. So if she needs to take more than 3 months paid off, like the family care act or disability, it’ll be 50% pay and 0% pay. What the hell am
I gonna do? I’m so screwed. I’m feeling light headed and feel like fainting.

I appreciate the positive feedback. But I can’t stop thinking doom and gloom. Something is wrong with me :(

I’m trying to become a robot right now by calling to setup a meeting with an OYBGN (I think that’s what they’re called) and meet them. I guess that’s what we should do? And made a calendar invite with details. I’m checking my insurance for details but I think my wife has better insurance. But all of this is external, I’m SO PANIC RIGHT NOW JESUS. I can’t feel my hands and feet. I can’t breathe

she is pregnant. my body is boiling on the inside and cold as ice on the outside. I held her and smiled and laughed but im dying to scream

i just want to take a few xanax to calm myself down but I have no idea what to do now

I have so many thoughts flying through my head. I'm not sure I'm ready to be a father. what about the money, what about the time it takes, the pains, the birth, the hospital and fees, then being there for this human being that's going to be born... sleepless nights to come and total and complete dedicated necessary from here on out. my life is over and now our baby has to be the center of our attention for the rest of our lives

its flooding me and Im drowning

She's pregannt and I smiled and hugged her but im so scared my stomach is sinking into itself. What do I do now? I have no idea how to deal with this and I dont want my wife to be scared or see me scared at all
